NewsArticle.Title: New Referral Program
NewsArticle.Content: Starting October 29th, 2001, Nexon USA has geared up to offer our gamers an opportunity to add play time to their game accounts! The program is fun and simple: introduce a friend to any Nexon game, and if he or she creates an account with us, we will add seven days of time to your game account. The more friends you refer, the more time you earn. But this is a limited offer, so the sooner you start, the more free fun you can enjoy!
